item.title: ●●|●●●●●|●●|●: One of the top two articles on a site dedicated to writing...
item.content:encoded:
…is a format screw designed to preclude writing. You have to love the irony.

I wonder if 2521 really is unable to identify infographic information about itself, or if it merely feels indifferent about visual forms of communication. I can imagine it impassively glancing over the infographic documentation while peering over the shoulder of a researcher, wondering, "Sheesh, why did they start communicating about me in such an unfun format? This doesn't spark joy. I'm not gonna bother bringing any more of these people back to my cool tree fort. And here I thought they were friendly! Lame."

item.title: SCP-3042: A whole lot of nothing
item.content:encoded: This is an interesting idea, but I feel like it drags on too long. A large portion of the article is dedicated to redundantly establishing that the dog is indestructible and a menace, and… that's it. There isn't any payoff. It isn't sad or scary or funny or thought provoking, it's just there. A lot. To me, it feels like a wasted opportunity. The concept of "indestructible, troublesome dog" can make for some interesting stories (think Lilo and Stitch), and maybe there are/will be some fun tales with this scip. But judging the article strictly by its own merit, I have to downvote. Sorry.

item.title: SCP-5923: Addendums
item.content:encoded:
I enjoyed reading this, as others commented, this article has a sense of sadness for places that are no more… I liked that the anomaly is not malevolent, nor wants to do harm. It just wants to be visited!

Also, nice way to explain the discovery of the anomaly, it is not so easy to do this for an anomaly that happens only in some circumstances!

The reading was somewhat strange, because the "addendum" box style didn't look like to be clicked, so I just continued reading. After reaching the end of the article, and returned to read the ConProc section, it made sense to me, I thought I missed the mention of Cap. Waltham. After going all the way down again, I saw in the footnotes that here was some entries that I didn't see in the text! So I clicked the addendums, to finally understand the missing pieces…

item.title: SCP-4570: if you have a town full of animals and not one good-time jamboree jug band, then i don't know what to tell you
item.content:encoded: It was… fine? There weren't any major problems and it seems like this was executed with a fine level of technical skill. But there isn't much there there. I didn't get the sense of anything meaningful or worth caring about, just a bunch of people turned into animals; the author commentary makes it seem like there was an attempt to split the difference between profound and goofy, with the end result that it's too shallow for the former and too lengthy for the latter. -1
